Subject: AWS co-sell introduction request — CloudWave <> Redwood (joint account plan + sync)

Hi Sarah and Mike,

Quick intro — Mike, meet Sarah Liu from the AWS GTM team; Sarah, meet Mike Davison, Head of Platform at CloudWave. CloudWave is evaluating Redwood for inference across a multi-region deployment and would like to explore the AWS co-sell path.

Goal: get a 45-minute alignment call this week to agree on a mutual action plan (roles, timeline, data/security questions) and confirm required AWS assets for a co-sell handoff. I attached a short MA plan template and our one-pager to speed the kickoff.

Proposed agenda (30-45 min):
- 5m quick intros + objectives
- 10m CloudWave use case + success criteria
- 10m Redwood solution & model/infra fit (technical owner)
- 10m AWS GTM asks / success criteria for co-sell
- 5-10m next steps / timeline / action owners

Suggested times (Pacific):
- Thu 9/30 3:00–3:45pm PT
- Fri 10/1 10:00–10:45am PT
- Fri 10/1 1:00–1:45pm PT

If these don't work, please propose two alternatives. Mike — could you paste a 2–3 bullet summary of the primary success metrics and any procurement constraints?

Thanks — Connor
Connor O'Brien
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0187
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_template.xlsx (xlsx), redwood-platform-one-pager.pdf (pdf)

Subject: Re: AWS co-sell introduction request — CloudWave <> Redwood (joint account plan + sync)

Thanks for the intro, Connor. Happy to help — I can join as the AWS GTM lead and loop in an AWS Solutions Architect if we need a deeper technical review.

Good windows: Fri 10/1 10:00–10:45am PT or Mon 10/4 11:00–11:45am PT.

Mike: would be helpful to confirm the primary workload (batch scoring vs. low-latency API), expected QPS, and whether data residency requirements are a blocker. If you can drop a short summary in reply, my SA can pre-prepare a couple of notes on recommended AWS account access and AWS Partner funding assets that may be available for co-sell.

Sarah Liu
AWS GTM — Strategic Partners
sliu@amazon.com

Connor / Sarah — thanks for looping me in. Short answers:
- Workload: primarily low-latency API (customer-facing inference) with some nightly batch re-scoring.
- Expected peak: ~400 concurrent requests (avg token lengths short), ramp to 2k rps within 12 months if pilot succeeds.
- Data residency: must be US-only for initial phase (FedRAMP not required but SOC2 + audit logs are mandatory).
- Procurement: standard SaaS PO will be used; procurement lead is Rebecca Jones (rebecca.jones@cloudwave.com).

I can do Fri 10/1 10:00–10:45am PT. Looking forward to the intro. I added a simple diagram of our data flow for context (attached).

—Mike
